description: relay_client.rs:92,116,216 — three // SAFETY: comments explain why std::sync::Mutex is used before an .await. SAFETY comments are a Rust convention reserved for unsafe blocks (see nomicon). Applying them to safe code trains readers to skim SAFETY comments as 'async boundary note', weakening their signal value when they appear on actual unsafe blocks. Rename to // NOTE: or // INVARIANT: to preserve the convention.
title: SAFETY comments in relay_client.rs misapplied to std::sync::Mutex usage
